text: きょうは　おしえごと　いっしょに　せきしつを　みに　きました

structure.jp: おしえごと　いっしょに
せきしつを　みに　きました
structure.en: I came to see the stone chambers

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: A verb with its ます taken off, plus に and a verb of coming or going, tells what you come or go to do. みに　きました = 'came to see'.

patterns.name: 〜といっしょに
patterns.span: おしえごと　いっしょに
patterns.explanation: と after a person plus いっしょに means 'together with' that person. おしえごと　いっしょに = 'together with my pupil'.
